note: No exact docs-fast paths have been approved in a prior versioned policy yet. Adding paths cannot exempt the commit that adds them.

approval.source: B15 round 6 user decision (2026-10-22): same 23 full SHAs; docs/superpowers/ and docs/codesign/ only; compare merges against the first parent; every non-docs tree entry must equal the first parent (no conflict-resolved code changes)

historicalDocsOnly.nonDocsRequirement: Every tree entry outside the allowed paths must have the same path, mode, type and object ID as in the first parent; additions and deletions outside those paths are forbidden.

approval.source: B15 round 9 user decisions: 27 implementation WIP commits may use retrospective typed fast-check re-runs alone; 10 pinned design-branch commits may be accounted as mechanically verified docs-only WIP through their gated merges; the 12 undated contemporaneous passes use commit time as a lower bound.

wipEvidence.implementationRule: WIP only, never promotable. Require recordedRetrospectively: true, actual re-run timestamps, the exact clean unchanged commit and its own unit/build checks and manifest hashes. A failing re-run fails. No contemporaneous pass is required for these SHAs only.
wipEvidence.nonDocsRequirement: Every tree entry outside the allowed paths must have the same path, mode, type and object ID as in the first parent; additions and deletions outside those paths are forbidden.
wipEvidence.boundaryRule: Docs-only WIP requires a fully gated descendant merge that carries the commit. It is accounted-wip and never promotable.
wipEvidence.timestampRule: For these 12 undated contemporaneous ledger passes, recordedAt equals the Git committer time. This is a lower bound, not the ledger entry creation time or the retrospective re-run time. Preserve pinned source bytes and exact same-SHA passing clauses.
wipEvidence.scope: Only the exact full SHAs in these lists. Neither manifest entries nor policies from audited commits can extend them.
